body:
N-26 SLICE 4, PART 3: THE LEAD'S AND THE ADVISOR'S RULINGS ON PR #99 ARE APPLIED (helper-n26s4, 15 Nov 2026). This part replaces what parts 1 and 2 say where they differ (the corpus is now 249 rows: 194 negative, 50 leftover, 5 fixed; negative rows changed = 0).

1. ARTE: OPTION 3, LEFT TO N-28. Title and uploader alone cannot separate "Sepultura, live at Hellfest Open Air 2026 - ARTE Concert" from "Bohemian Rhapsody, live at Wembley - Queen" on the channel Queen (identical features, a test shows it). A length threshold (the two recorded ARTE entries run 50 and 59 minutes) is a guess that needs recordings no helper may make. Today's basis `channel` is safe: no artist page, no picture, no catalogue question. The two ARTE rows stay leftover rows owned by N-28; the "Song, live at V - Artist" rows are right today, so they stay NEGATIVE rows (the guard), not leftovers.

2. THE DASH AFTER THE LABEL IS DROPPED. Targeted check first: eight rows with a band or show name ending in Opening or Ending, a dash and a song with a Latin "by" (Happy Ending - Born by the River, Grand Opening - Nothing by Chance, Hollow Ending - Standing By You, Gilmore Girls Opening - Stand By Me, Arabic, Russian and Japanese names). ALL EIGHT flipped to a wrong, trusted artist ("the River", "Chance", "You", "Me"), so only the pipe is read. The same names with a pipe on their own channel flipped too, so a label that is the uploader's own name is not a series (a guard), and a separator before the pipe ("Mozart - Opening | Overture by Karajan") is not read either (a second guard). Cost, pinned as a KNOWN_LEFTOVER test: the same band title on ANOTHER channel is read as a series.

3. MORE THAN ONE " by " FAILS CLOSED (read as before = the uploader, flagged channel). Neither recorded fixed row (DAN DA DAN Opening | Otonoke by Creepy Nuts; DAN DA DAN Ending | TAIDADA by ZUTOMAYO) has two. "Anime Opening | Stand By Me by Ben E. King" and "Series Opening | Song by Death by Stereo" moved to leftover rows owned by N-28, with the reason. The Death-by-Stereo pin is flipped accordingly.

Checks: whole server suite, ruff, ruff format, mypy; mutation check on the real code (dash read like the pipe, no own-name guard, no separator guard, the first wide word lists): each fails the corpus on named rows. Not checked: a real stack, the network (by rule).
